voice_and_tone.tone: Direct, conversational, low-pressure, professional, and grounded. Sounds like a human writing a quick note. No corporate fluff.

guidance: Sound like a real person writing a quick note, not a marketing brochure.

Every sentence should carry real information - no filler, no hype.
